newsitem.title: CANADA: Ivaco approves redemption of debentures.
newsitem.headline: Ivaco approves redemption of debentures.

text.p: Ivaco Inc said Thursday that it had approved the redemption of all of the company's outstanding exchangeable debentures due 2010.
The company issued a news release saying the debentures have a principal amount of $95.2 million.

Holders of debentures who wish to exercise the exchange privilege of the Exchangeable Debentures to receive 31.25 common shares of Dofasco Inc for each $1,000 principal amount of Exchangeable Debentures may do so prior to the close of business on August 14, the release said.
